description: Drone/survey quantities and subcontractor-claimed quantities are not compared on a common KP/section basis
consequence: Discrepancies found late or not at all; overpayment risk
evidence_needed: Sample of 3 past certificates with claim vs survey per section

description: Daily production recorded on paper/Excel at shift end from memory; incomplete or inconsistent units
consequence: Reported quantities unreliable as reconciliation input
evidence_needed: Audit 20 DPRs for missing fields and unit errors
candidate_requirement: Structured mobile form with mandatory fields and unit validation

description: Flight timing does not match activity windows; buried works (lowering/padding/backfill layers) may be missed
consequence: Some quantities not independently measurable after the fact
evidence_needed: Flight log vs activity times for 2 weeks
candidate_requirement: Flight-window planning linked to activity schedule; photo evidence fallback

description: Accuracy (GCP/RTK checks) of each flight not systematically reported with volumes
consequence: Measured volumes can be challenged by subcontractor
candidate_requirement: Uncertainty (±) attached to each measured quantity

description: Drone outputs arrive as PDFs/screenshots by email and are not linked to BoQ items
consequence: Evidence search effort; manual reading errors
evidence_needed: Count of evidence files per claim and time to assemble
candidate_requirement: Ingest exports into a georeferenced store linked to quantities

description: Crew composition and equipment hours not linked to activity and section
consequence: Productivity per crew/section unknown; slowdowns detected late
candidate_requirement: Crew/equipment assignment per shift per activity/KP range

description: Same quantity re-keyed 3-4 times across DPR / tracker / QS workbook / ERP
evidence_needed: Trace 10 quantities across all files and count differences
candidate_requirement: Capture-once data flow with system-of-record per state

description: Subcontractor daily reports in own format with own activity names and location references
candidate_requirement: Shared activity/BoQ taxonomy and KP section register

description: Subcontractor timesheets not cross-checked with gate/badge or equipment data
evidence_needed: Sample dayworks claims vs site records

description: Joint measurement disputes over quantities already covered or restored
consequence: Delayed certification; management time; relationship strain
evidence_needed: Dispute log: count; value; days to close
candidate_requirement: Near-daily agreed quantities with time-stamped evidence

description: Progress % updated weekly from re-keyed data; no live view by work front
consequence: Late reaction to delays; inaccurate forecasting
evidence_needed: Lag between work and progress update

description: Personnel location/headcount by zone not known in real time
consequence: Muster and emergency response slower; privacy must be respected if tracked

description: No detection of duplicate claims (same KP range/item claimed twice or overlapping periods)
evidence_needed: Check past claims for overlapping KP ranges
candidate_requirement: Automatic overlap/duplicate check per item and KP range

description: Signature chain and ERP re-entry delay payment after agreement
evidence_needed: Dates: period end to certificate to payment
candidate_requirement: Digital approval workflow and structured export to ERP

description: Tolerances and measurement rules applied inconsistently between QS staff and claims
evidence_needed: Compare treatment of similar items across certificates
candidate_requirement: Explicit tolerance and measurement-rule catalogue per BoQ item
